verdict.rationale: A government tax portal could plausibly offer a conversational or natural-language interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only form-based Webfile behind authenticated eSystems, phone filing, PDF forms, and a keyless Socrata open-data query endpoint. That endpoint is a developer building block, not a natural-language command interface. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec, and nothing documents an assistant, chatbot, or natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
